# Maharashtra Times Swasthya Sangam 2027

> A one-day health summit, expo, masterclasses and awards in Mumbai on 30 Jan 2027, by Maharashtra Times and Times Internet Languages Live. Language: English.

Swasthya Sangam brings together hospitals, doctors, pharma, diagnostics, MedTech and HealthTech, wellness brands, insurers, AYUSH practitioners, government and health officials, investors and medical students. Four experiences share one day: Summit, Masterclasses, Expo and Awards ceremony. Five themes guide every session: People, Innovation, Access, Prevention and Impact.

Facts: Date 30 Jan 2027. City Mumbai, Maharashtra, India. Venue to be announced. Speakers and session timings to be announced.

## Registration passes
- Basic pass: Rs 1,499 (was Rs 1,999). Session access only. No lunch and no networking arena access.
- Premium pass: Rs 1,999 (was Rs 2,999). Session access, lunch and networking arena access.

## Awards
Nominations are open for hospitals, doctors and health brands across Maharashtra. An independent jury scores each nomination. Nominations are subject to evaluation and are not an assurance of any award or recognition. Three nomination plans: Standard Entry, Spotlight Plan and Elite Entry; prices are exclusive of GST and are listed on the Awards page.
